weather_report:
Perth dozes under a quiet sky at this hour, the streets held in a cool hush and only a few thin clouds wandering above. Toward dawn those clouds look set to keep their distance, letting the morning open clean and bright. Expect a mostly sunny start with crisp, clear light and good visibility, the kind of clarity that sharpens edges and makes colors behave. As the sun climbs, the UV will rise quickly for spring here, running moderate to high by late morning despite the mild start.

It reads as a pleasant day in the making: comfortable early, then warm on the skin once the sun finds its stride. Dress in light layers you can peel away, and have sunglasses and sunscreen ready after breakfast. If you’re up with the birds, put a wash on and let the breeze do the work, take a short ride or a steady walk before traffic wakes, or sit by a window with coffee and a list you actually mean to finish. By midday, if you’re out, lean into the shade and keep water close; the light will be generous and a little insistent.
